rdfs:label: inDataset
rdfs:comment: Deprecated. Intended to link a DCAT Distribution to its Dataset as an inverse of `dcat:distribution`, but DCAT defines no such property.
notes: Deprecated: `dcat:inDataset` does not exist in any version of DCAT (it is absent from https://www.w3.org/ns/dcat.ttl), and DCAT defines no inverse of `dcat:distribution`. Link a Dataset to its Distributions from the Dataset side with `http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#distribution` (in JSON-LD, `{"@reverse": {"http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#distribution": ...}}` if you must start from the Distribution).

examples.title: Use dcat:distribution from the Dataset side instead

history.note: Deprecated: dcat:inDataset does not exist in DCAT; removed owl:sameAs, pointed notes/example/provenance at dcat:distribution.
